scope: SP11 Windows qcadcm hardware-resource traffic from qcadcm module load through normal boot completion
status: GREEN negative closure for the normal qcadcm boot path

method.debugger: classic kd.exe over KDNET via SP7 ConPTY

breakpoints.name: AudioHwRscIoctl
breakpoints.observation: arguments plus bounded host-memory buffer read

breakpoints.name: gsl_command_hw_rsc_custom_config
breakpoints.observation: request size, command, and bounded host-memory payload read

conclusion: A loader-trapped qcadcm boot trace captures the complete normal qcadcm hardware-resource request/release sequence from module load onward and contains only hardware-core, clock, and endpoint-GPIO resources. Qualcomm's private codec-register resource 0x0800131b is never requested. Combined with the REV_0D ACDB negative search and the marked speaker-playback trace, the normal SP11 internal-speaker host path does not source a hidden WSA-macro register program through qcadcm.
remaining_boundary: The private DSP service may exist for other modes/clients, but it is not part of the observed normal boot or marked internal-speaker playback path. The remaining Windows-vs-Linux WSA producer difference must be sought inside ADSP/HAL/platform runtime state, silicon/reset behavior, or another non-qcadcm mechanism.
